name: viewdoctor
description: Local SwiftUI diff checks with module ownership for people and coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Check SwiftUI diffs locally with module ownership.
interface.longDescription: ViewDoctor scans changed Swift files, maps SwiftPM, Tuist, and Xcode modules, and returns compact findings without uploading source code.
interface.defaultPrompt: Run ViewDoctor on my changed Swift files and fix actionable findings.
